In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.Your Tasks:Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization. Your Profile:Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Please apply on our website: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/d2a51a4a-7510-400a-b141-e3883b9e02bdLast application date is Desember 31st, 2026

title: Skipstjóri á rib bát
description: Við leitum að ábyrgum, jákvæðum og öryggismeðvituðum skipstjóra til að starfa við hvalaskoðun á RIB-bátum okkar í Húsavík. Um er að ræða spennandi starf þar sem lögð er áhersla á framúrskarandi þjónustu, öryggi og einstaka upplifun gesta.Umsækjendur skulu hafa gild réttindi sem viðurkennd eru af Samgöngustofu fyrir atvinnusiglingar með farþega á Íslandi, þar á meðal:✅ Gild skipstjóraréttindi (t.d. Smáskipaskírteini / Coastal Skipper Certificate eða sambærileg erlend réttindi sem viðurkennd eru á Íslandi)✅ Gilt fjarskiptaskírteini (ROC, GOC, SRC eða sambærilegt)✅ Gilda STCW Basic Safety Training vottun✅ Gilt læknisvottorð sjómanna (Seafarer's Medical Certificate)✅ Sannanlegan siglingatíma ef þess er krafist til viðurkenningar erlendra réttinda✅ Rétt til að starfa á ÍslandiKostur er ef umsækjandi hefur:✅Reynslu af stjórnun RIB-báta eða annarra hraðskreiðra farþegabáta✅Reynslu af hvalaskoðun eða annarri ferðaþjónustu á sjó✅Þekkingu á öryggisstjórnun og neyðarviðbrögðum✅Góða enskukunnáttu (önnur tungumál eru kostur)Við leitum að einstaklingi sem:✅Hefur gaman af samskiptum við fólk frá ólíkum menningarheimum✅Hefur áhuga á hvölum, náttúru og lífríki sjávar✅Er jákvæður, ábyrgur og lausnamiðaður✅Getur unnið sjálfstætt sem og í nánu samstarfi við aðraVið bjóðum upp á fjölbreytt og skemmtilegt starf í hjarta hvalaskoðunar á Íslandi, góðan starfsanda og tækifæri til að vinna á sjó á einum fallegasta stað landsins.Fyrir frekari upplýsingar og umsókn, vinsamlegast sendið á whales@husavikadventures.is eða hringið í síma +354 8599585 (Berta Maria) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Húsavík Adventures is hiring a RIB Whale Watching Captain!We are looking for a responsible, safety-conscious, and enthusiastic captain to operate our RIB whale watching vessels in Húsavík, Iceland. This role combines safe vessel operation with delivering outstanding guest experiences in one of the world's top whale watching destinations.Applicants must hold qualifications recognized by the Icelandic Transport Authority (Samgöngustofa) for commercial passenger operations, including:✅ Valid skipper/captain certification (Coastal Skipper Certificate, Small Commercial Vessel Certificate, or equivalent qualification recognized in Iceland)✅ Valid radio operator certificate (ROC, GOC, SRC, or equivalent)✅ Valid STCW Basic Safety Training certification✅ Valid Seafarer's Medical Certificate✅ Documented sea service where required for recognition of foreign qualifications✅ Legal right to work in IcelandPreferred Qualifications:✅Experience operating RIBs or other high-speed passenger vessels✅Experience in whale watching, tourism, or passenger transport operations✅Knowledge of maritime safety management and emergency procedures✅Strong English communication skills; additional languages are an advantageWe are looking for someone who:✅Enjoys working with people from around the world✅Has a genuine interest in whales, marine wildlife, and nature✅Is professional, reliable, and safety-focused✅Works well both independently and as part of a teamWe offer a unique opportunity to work in Iceland's whale watching capital, alongside a passionate and professional team dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences for our guests.Please send your application, CV and copies of relevant certificates to whales@husavikadventures.is

title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

description: Venue Operations and Client Support Co-OrdinatorAgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons FarmPosition type    Full-time Fixed Term for 24 monthsLocation    AgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons Research Farm, Celbridge, Co KildareReports to    Director of Innovation UCDSalary    €60,000 per year Hours    37 hours Full-time, with occasional evening and weekend eventsAbout AgTechUCDAgTechUCD is University College Dublin’s innovation centre for early-stage start-ups and SMEs working in agri, agtech, agrifood and veterinary sectors. Part of NovaUCD, it builds on NovaUCD’s track record of supporting high-tech start-ups. It is a collaboration between UCD and a network of industry, investor and research partners.AgTechUCD is a collaboration between NovaUCD, Kildare County Council, and Kildare LEO and is funded by the Regional Enterprise Development Fund. It also includes support from agri-companies such as; Devenish, Dairymaster, and Glanbia; investors such as; The Yield Lab, and Atlantic Bridge, along with leading AgTech researchers and innovators at UCD, Teagasc and Wageningen University and Research, Netherlands.  The AgTech Innovation Centre is based at UCD Lyons Farm, the University’s research and teaching farm. The building (about 890 sq.m.) offers flexible lab spaces, meeting rooms, offices and an exhibition space, and sits alongside the UCD Bimeda Herd Health Hub. It is home to a growing community of resident companies and is also available as a venue for events, workshops and industry gatherings.The RoleWe are looking for an energetic, organised and practical Venue Operations and Client Support Co-Ordinator to run the building day to day and to grow its profile as a venue for events and home for AgTech Start Up companies.This is primarily an operations role, with a meaningful commercial side. You will spend roughly 60% of your time on operations (building, events delivery and resident support and financial management and reporting) and 40% on marketing and sales (promoting the venue, winning event bookings and building relationships). An important part of the role is attracting clients to take up space in the incubator be it office or lab space and also selling the exhibition area and meeting rooms as an important event space.  A key requirement of the role is to attract business to the incubator and ensure it is an attractive area for prospective clients.  You will be the first point of contact for our resident companies and for everyone who hires or visits the space.Flexibility is required in this role (in working hours and tasks) and excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as a willingness to travel as needed and a full driving licence will all be essential for this positionKey Responsibilities1. Building and Facilities Operations•    Oversee the daily running of the building, including access control, opening and closing procedures and building security.•    Act as the main point of contact for maintenance and building services and out-of-hours contacts. Manage relationships with contractors and service providers (for example HVAC, plumbing, electrical, IT and broadband), log and prioritise issues, and make sure repairs are completed promptly. Technical repairs are carried out by qualified contractors; you coordinate and follow up.•    Carry out regular building walk-throughs to keep the centre clean, organised and safe, and to meet Health and Safety requirements, including the specific requirements of a lab and farm-campus environment.•    Liaise with UCD campus services and Lyons Farm colleagues on shared infrastructure, site access and safety procedures.•    Manage inventory and ordering for kitchen supplies, office consumables and event equipment.2. Event Coordination and Delivery•    Act as the primary contact for internal and external event hosts, from first enquiry through to delivery and follow-up.•    Prepare event spaces before bookings and reset them promptly afterwards, including room layouts and equipment setup.•    Provide on-the-ground support during events, including A/V and lighting setup, layout changes and immediate troubleshooting.•    Coordinate third-party suppliers such as caterers, equipment hire companies and cleaners.•    Gather feedback after events and use it to improve the venue offering.3. Resident Company Support and Community•    Be the day-to-day go-to person for resident start-ups and SMEs, creating a welcoming, collaborative and energetic atmosphere.•    Manage onboarding and offboarding of resident companies, including induction, access, desk and lab space allocation and handover.•    Organise community activities that add value for residents, such as networking sessions, coffee mornings, skill-sharing sessions and visits from investors, industry partners and researchers.•    Work closely with the AgTechUCD and NovaUCD teams to support accelerator programme activity and events hosted in the building.4. Venue Marketing and Event Sales•    Promote the venue to corporate clients, agri-food and agtech networks, industry bodies, community groups and external event organisers, with the aim of growing event booking revenue.•    Develop and run marketing activity for the venue, including social media content, creative materials, newsletters and direct outreach.•    Conduct site tours for prospective clients, presenting the layout options, technical capability and amenities of the building.•    Create and maintain attractive event packages covering room layouts, technical setup and catering partnerships, with clear pricing.•    Manage the enquiry-to-booking process, track leads and bookings, and report regularly on occupancy and revenue.•    Build relationships with local and sector networks in the agri-food, agtech and university communities to raise the profile of the building as a destination for events.5. Financial Management/Governance and Reporting•    Report to various stakeholders both internal and external including the UCD Director of Innovation and the UCD Nova DAC board•    Process RFQs, tenders , raise requisitions and close out the purchasing process adhering to UCDs procurement process.•    Create and issue Client/Customer monthly invoices and manage and report on De Minimus passthrough.Essential Skills and Experience•    2 to 4 years’ experience in venue management, events coordination, hospitality, co-working or innovation-space operations, or a similar customer-facing role.•    Proven ability to manage a building or venue in practice: coordinating contractors, solving problems quickly and keeping standards high.•    Experience promoting a venue, service or brand through social media, networking and direct outreach, and converting enquiries into bookings.•    A friendly, confident and professional manner, with the ability to build strong relationships with start-up founders, clients and suppliers.•    Strong organisational skills and a hands-on, “no task too small” attitude. description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico ICP OES/ICP MS Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. Il posizionamento all'interno della fascia sarà determinato sulla base delle competenze e dell'esperienza professionale coerenti con i requisiti della posizione. *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). For FERRERO ARDENNES, a global leader in the confectionery industry, we are recruiting: MECHANICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS FOR FERRERO - BELGIUM At Ferrero's ARLON site you will find: Highly automated production lines and latest-generation Industry 4.0 technologies A solid, structured and merit-based organization that values strategic maintenance skills An international environment with many colleagues who have relocated from Italy and from all over the world What you will do The selected candidate will join the maintenance team (about 90 people) and will be responsible for routine, extraordinary, preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance on automated systems within the Arlon production site. title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Hybrid working model: Smart Working options and flexible hours to help you achieve a better work-life balance. title: To stipendiatstillingar ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze
employer: UNIVERSITETET I BERGEN DET HUMANISTISKE FAKULTET
description:
Stipendiat

Det er ledig to stipendiatstillingar (100%) ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze. Oppstart i stillingane i september 2027. Stillingane er ledig for ein periode på tre (3) år, med moglegheit for stipend for eit fjerde år. 

Stillingane er finansierte av det norske kunnskapsdepartementet. Stipendiatane vert teken opp i eit av ph.d.-programma ved EUI, med Universitetet i Bergen som arbeidsgjevar.

Om EUI og ph.d.-programma

European University Institute er eit europeisk forskingsuniversitet innan humaniora og samfunnsvitskap som ligg i Firenze i Italia. EUI har ph.d.-program innan historie, økonomi, samfunnsvitskap og rettsvitskap. Stipendiatane knytt til ph.d.-programma kjem frå 25 ulike europeiske land. Gruppa med stipendiatar er organisert i kull, med samtidig oppstart kvar haust. 

Søkjarane som får tilbod om stipendiatstilling, får opptak til eitt av dei fire ph.d.-programma. 

Ph.d.-utdanninga er normert til fire år.

Meir informasjon om EUI, programma og søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes

Kvalifikasjonar og krav:
  • Søkjaren må vere norsk statsborgar eller ha permanent opphaldsløyve i Noreg.
  • Søkjaren må ha mastergrad eller tilsvarande grad. 
  • Søkjarar som har fullført doktorgrad, kan ikkje bli tilsette i stipendiatstilling innan det same fagområdet.
  • Det er EUI som vurderer om fagbakgrunnen til dei som søkjer opptak er relevant for det einskilde ph.d.-program.
Løn og andre vilkår:
  • Løn som stipendiat, som for tida svarar til ei brutto årsløn på NOK 593.700.
  • Etableringsstipend det første året etter satsane til forskingsrådet: NOK 300 000 for enkeltperson og NOK 516 000 ved familie
  • Driftsmidlar: NOK 50 000 pr år
  • Stipend det fjerde året. Opptak til det fjerde året må stipendiaten søkja EUI om. Ved innvilga opptak vert det gjeve stipend frå EUI og UiB.
Slik søkjer du stillinga:

Lenke til EUI sitt søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes.

Informasjon om faglege krav i søknaden, innhald i programmet og arbeidskvardagen kan ein få ved å sjå på «FAQs and Contacts» under det einskilde program. 

Generell informasjon:

Informasjon om arbeidsforholdet til UiB og UiB si forvaltning av avtalen kan ein få ved å kontakte: 

Seniorrådgiver Yngve Brynjulfsen, yngve.brynjulfsen@uib.no, 

+47 55 58 33 82 

    

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Bergen er ein anerkjend utdannings- og forskingsinstitusjon, organisert i sju fakultet og omlag 54 institutt og faglege senter. Campus ligg i sentrale delar av Bergen med universitetsområde på Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien og Årstad.

Det humanistiske fakultet består av fire institutt og fire senter. Les meir om fakultet og tilhøyrande institutt.

description: Sei un talento nelle vendite e cerchi un'opportunità per esprimere il tuo potenziale? Ti piace costruire relazioni con i clienti e collaborazioni solide? Potremmo avere l'opportunità giusta per te! Grafton Sales&Marketing è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati nei ruoli di vendita e marketing. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda leader nel mondo della distribuzione moderna organizzata con focus nel canale Ho.Re.Ca. selezioniamo: DIGITAL SALES - Ho.Re.Ca. Per realtà che vanta oltre 50 anni di esperienza al fianco di tutti i professionisti della ristorazione e dell'ospitalità, offre la possibilità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante, caratterizzato da un continuo ascolto dei trend di mercato e dalla volontà di cogliere sempre nuove sfide commerciali, volte alla crescita economica e ad un sempre maggiore presidio del mercato. Specialista nel food service Horeca pone ogni giorno 'il cliente al centro' attraverso l'elevata consulenza professionale del proprio Team commerciale ed un servizio logistico puntuale e costante. Di cosa ti occuperai? Farai parte di un'azienda determinata a valorizzare al meglio i propri venditori, quali elementi chiave tra azienda e cliente e portavoce della Mission aziendale. con l'obiettivo principale di vendere in maniera proattiva soluzioni e servizi digitali ai clienti per fidelizzarli ulteriormente: - Scouting dei potenziali clienti interessati all'attivazione e al testing di servizi/tool digitali; - Vendita proattiva e diretta di tool/servizi digitali (es: Costruzione siti web, tool di prenotazione tavoli e ordini online + sistema gestionale di cassa POS + sistema di pagamento DISH PAY) ai clienti già fidelizzati; - Conversione dei leads e altri canali; - Assistenza post-vendita sui tool/servizi ai clienti, per supportare il cliente nel generare valore aggiunto al proprio business; - Monitora e raccoglie feedback dai clienti e dal mercato in ottica di miglioramento della strategia di vendita e del prodotto. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - Pregressa esperienza di almeno 2 anni in contesti di consulenza e vendita B2B di servizi/soluzioni digitali nel canale Horeca; - In possesso di Patente B; - Diploma di Scuola Media Superiore; - Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali, passione per la vendita, capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione. È inoltre prevista diaria giornaliera del valore di 16€, previsto un sistema incentivante secondo i criteri definiti dalla contrattazione aziendale, auto uso promiscuo, PC, Cellulare, carta carburante. title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Per conto di una nota realtà operativa nel settore alberghiero, in vista della nuova apertura di una struttura su Roma, siamo alla ricerca di un/una: HR Manager Le mansioni del ruolo sono le seguenti: Reclutamento e inserimento ? Gestire l'intero processo di reclutamento e selezione per tutte le posizioni della struttura; ? Redigere e pubblicare annunci di lavoro in linea con gli standard editoriali e di brand. ? Condurre colloqui, coordinare i processi di selezione con i responsabili di dipartimento e sottoporre le proprie raccomandazioni al General Manager. ? Organizzare e condurre il processo di onboarding e inserimento di tutti i nuovi dipendenti, affinché ciascuno possa iniziare al meglio fin dal primo giorno. ? Gestire i rapporti con i partner di reclutamento e monitorare l'efficacia dei canali di ricerca (ad es. scuole, università, istituzioni). ? Coordinare la pianificazione e le tempistiche delle assunzioni tra i diversi dipartimenti, per garantire che l'hotel disponga del personale adeguato al momento dell'apertura. Amministrazione e payroll ? Predisporre, verificare e gestire tutti i contratti di lavoro e la relativa documentazione amministrativa, in conformità alla normativa italiana sul lavoro e agli standard del Gruppo. ? Gestire il rilevamento delle presenze, i diritti alle ferie e la pianificazione dei turni, in coordinamento con i responsabili di dipartimento. ? Coordinare la raccolta e la verifica dei dati payroll e interfacciarsi con il fornitore esterno del servizio paghe, garantendo elaborazioni corrette e puntuali. ? Coordinare tutte le formalità amministrative relative all'onboarding e all'offboarding dei dipendenti: documentazione, iscrizione agli enti previdenziali, visite mediche, documenti di cessazione e conteggi finali. ? Garantire la conformità alla normativa italiana sul lavoro e ai contratti collettivi applicabili, in coordinamento con il consulente esterno in materia giuslavoristica. Gestione del personale e relazioni con i dipendenti ? Essere il principale punto di riferimento HR in loco per tutti i dipendenti e i responsabili di dipartimento. ? Monitorare le relazioni tra dipendenti e management, individuando e gestendo proattivamente per tempo eventuali criticità. ? Supportare e consigliare i responsabili di dipartimento nella gestione delle persone, nei procedimenti disciplinari e nelle questioni relative alle prestazioni. ? Gestire le comunicazioni formali, i procedimenti disciplinari e gli eventuali contenziosi, in collaborazione con la Direzione HR di Gruppo; ? Interfacciarsi, quando necessario, con i consulenti legali esterni sulle questioni relative alle relazioni di lavoro. ? Segnalare al General Manager e alla Direttrice HR del Gruppo, secondo necessità, le questioni rilevanti o delicate relative ai rapporti con i dipendenti. ? Promuovere una cultura del lavoro positiva, inclusiva e orientata a prestazioni elevate. Formazione e sviluppo ? Individuare e raccogliere le esigenze formative di tutti i dipartimenti. ? Coordinare e supportare l'erogazione delle sessioni formative in loco. ? Monitorare i piani di sviluppo individuali e assicurare il follow-up dei periodi di prova. ? Contribuire all'individuazione dei talenti e alla pianificazione delle successioni, in collaborazione con il General Manager e la Direttrice HR del Gruppo. Budget, costi del personale e reporting ? Elaborare il budget HR annuale in stretta collaborazione con il General Manager e il management del Gruppo. ? Predisporre report periodici per monitorare i costi del personale, l'organico e il rapporto tra costi del lavoro e budget. ? Contribuire al reporting HR e agli indicatori chiave a livello di Gruppo: organico, assenteismo, ore di formazione, tasso di turnover. ? Fornire regolarmente al General Manager report HR e raccomandazioni pertinenti a supporto delle decisioni operative e relative alla forza lavoro. Requisiti Richiesti: ? Esperienza comprovata in un ruolo di responsabilità di un dipartimento HR (trasversale a tutte le funzioni HR), nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso. ? Costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nella gestione autonoma di una funzione HR. ? Solida conoscenza della normativa italiana sul lavoro e delle disposizioni in materia di occupazione, con esperienza nel coordinamento di consulenti legali esterni e fornitori di servizi payroll. ? Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dell'intero processo di reclutamento, compreso l'utilizzo di piattaforme ATS. ? Familiarità con i sistemi informativi HR e gli strumenti payroll. ? Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Office, in particolare di Excel. ? Ottima conoscenza scritta e parlata dell'italiano e dell'inglese. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: dirigente delle risorse umane
description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Per potenziamento della funzione Acquisti tecnici a supporto dei plant, ricerchiamo un/una: Industrial Sr Buyer / Technical Procurement (CAPEX & MRO). La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. Principali responsabilità: Gestione end-to-end del sourcing su CAPEX, servizi tecnici e MRO: dal fabbisogno alla contrattualizzazione Impostazione e conduzione di RFQ/RFP e gare, con comparativi tecnico-economici e analisi TCO Negoziazione di condizioni commerciali e contratti (garanzie, penali, tempi di consegna, collaudi/accettazioni, ricambi e service) Definizione e gestione di accordi quadro e contratti di service con SLA/KPI, aumentando la copertura contrattuale della spesa ricorrente Vendor management: qualifica, monitoraggio performance, gestione criticità/claim, mitigazione rischi (lead time, single source, continuità assistenza) Supporto a Engineering/Manutenzione su standardizzazione, ricambistica critica e iniziative di miglioramento Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma tecnico (Perito Meccanico/Meccatronico) e/o Laurea in Ingegneria (preferenza Meccanica/Meccatronica/Industriale) Esperienza indicativa 5-10+ anni in acquisti tecnico-industriali in contesti manifatturieri strutturati Esposizione concreta a CAPEX e contrattualistica service, oltre a categorie MRO (ricambi, consumabili, manutenzioni) Familiarità con tendering strutturato, logiche TCO e disciplina di processo Buona padronanza di ERP/strumenti di procurement Inglese fluente per negoziazione e gestione fornitori internazionali Competenze manageriali e soft skills: Negoziazione evoluta e capacità di gestire trade-off costo/qualità/rischio/continuità Autorevolezza con stakeholder tecnici, forte orientamento all'execution e gestione priorità in contesto produttivo Comunicazione sintetica e capacità di escalation strutturata Approccio data-driven, rigore e affidabilità Sede di lavoro: Italia, area Emilia-Romagna, con trasferte prevalentemente nazionali e, in funzione dei progetti, internazionali. Attività prevalentemente on site. Offerta: inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Package indicativo: RAL €45.000-€55.000 + MBO ~10%. Eventuali benefit saranno definiti in base a inquadramento e policy aziendali. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description: We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a3D Production Manager (m/f/d)Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmYOUR TASKS:- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters- Actively contributing to the further development of our companyYOUR PROFILE:- Experience in leadership- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness- Fluent English (business level)OUR TOP 3 REASONS:- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design- Responsibility right from the start- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international companyAfter an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have.
